name: opencode-generated-agent-shape-v2
body:
The distributed `agent-builder` template generates opencode 2.x agents and maintains the repo-root `opencode.json` in the opencode 2.x shape.

Generated agents (the core/root `implementer`, each `<name>-implementer`, each tiered `test-implementer`, and the optional per-repo `release-agent`): each scaffolded file carries opencode 2.x native frontmatter — the fields `description`, `mode: subagent`, `model` (a reference carrying a variant joins as `provider/model#variant`), a Markdown body that becomes the agent's `system` prompt, the ordered `permissions` array with opencode 2.x action names and deny-by-default ordering, and any of `hidden`/`steps`/`color` on the generated agent — and carries zero of the legacy fields `temperature`, `top_p`, `prompt`, `permission`, `tools`, `disable`, and `maxSteps`. Each generated agent carries its own grant set: the code-writer's worktree-only `edit` globs (`apg/.worktrees/*/<glob>`) and its `apg_rm`/`apg_mv`/`apg_cp` path scope, and the optional release-agent's per-repo main-checkout write set.

The push/tag policy: the optional release-agent is the only generated agent with `git push`/`git tag`, and its rule effect is `ask`; every other generated agent carries those verbs denied (`requirements.constraint.push-tag-release-agent-carve-out`, `requirements.requirement.push-tag-human-approved-release-only`). The release-agent carries its `mode: subagent`, `hidden: true`, `generated: true` shape and its consent gate.

The repo-root `opencode.json` agent→model map uses the opencode 2.x shape: the `agents` key holds per-agent entries, and a model reference with a variant joins as `provider/model#variant`. The write merges non-destructively (only the interviewed `agents.<name>.model` entries change; unrelated keys and unmentioned entries survive) and omits `agents.codebase-navigator.model` (`requirements.constraint.agent-builder-model-map-scope`).

Acceptance criteria: `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` instructs the generation of opencode 2.x frontmatter with the V2-native fields and the `permissions` array and with zero of the legacy fields `temperature`/`top_p`/`prompt`/`permission`/`tools`/`disable`/`maxSteps`; the push/tag `ask` carve-out wording is present; the model-map instructions name the `agents` key and the `provider/model#variant` join; the map merge and the `codebase-navigator` exclusion are preserved.
